payload.name: Ventral striatal reward expectation signal
payload.fact: Ventral striatal neurons show sustained increases of activity before the occurrence of individual task events, specifically preceding the delivery of reward.

provenance.title: Neuronal activity in monkey ventral striatum related to the expectation of reward
provenance.quote_or_locus: In 43 of these neurons, activations specifically preceded the delivery of reward, independent of the movement or no-movement reaction
